Subject: Pilot onboarding + invoicing question

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the call earlier — excited about the AtlasML-Redwood pilot. Attached is a short SOW that covers the 3-month pilot (AtlasML_SOW.pdf). The pilot scope is small scale (single-tenant, up to 10k inference minutes / month).

A quick question for procurement: can we run the pilot without a PO? AtlasML typically invoices on Net30 and many pilots start with an invoice rather than a formal PO. If a PO is required, can you share the process and estimated lead time so we can align expectations?

Next steps from our side: we can sign your MSA via DocuSign and complete the security questionnaire (we have SOC 2 Type II) — I attached the SOW for reference.

Thanks,
Cassidy Park

Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding + invoicing question

Hi Cassidy — great to meet you on the call.

Short answer: procurement typically requires a PO for vendor onboarding, but we can request a limited exception for pilots where spend is capped and compliance checks are complete. I’ve looped in Rishi (procurement) and Marcus (finance) to confirm the internal path.

Proposed path from sales:
- We request a time-limited PO exception for the 3-month pilot (cap $30k).
- AtlasML completes security questionnaire and returns SOC 2 sig summary.
- Signed MSA in DocuSign before the first invoice.
- Invoicing on Net30 to Redwood Billing; finance will flag spend against a temporary project code.

Cassidy — please proceed with the security questionnaire and send over the billing contact. We’ll push for an expedited review but need procurement/finance approval.

–Kimberly
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: AtlasML pilot — PO exception request for initial trial

Team — reviewing AtlasML request. Checklist for a PO exception we typically require: 
1) Spend cap formally set (I recommend $30k for 90 days).
2) Signed MSA in DocuSign (attach template).
3) Completed security questionnaire and SOC 2 Type II evidence (summary acceptable).
4) One-time manual vendor setup in AP with billing contact and remit-to.
5) Procurement retains right to retroactively require a PO if pilot expands.

If leadership approves, procurement will open an exception ticket and create a temporary vendor ID so finance can accept invoices without a PO for the pilot period. 

Risks: vendor billing errors (we’ll require invoice-to account code), and the need to ensure we don’t bypass contractual terms the legal team would expect.

Requesting approval: Laura — can you sign off on a controlled exception with the conditions above? If approved, I’ll start the exception ticket and request temporary vendor setup with AP.

Attachments: MSA-template.docx

Rishi / team — approved with conditions.

I authorize a one-time, time-boxed PO exception for AtlasML under the following mandatory controls: 
- Pilot spend cap: $35,000 for a 90-day pilot (reasonably covers the expected usage + buffer).
- Signed MSA in DocuSign before the first invoice is processed.
- Completed security questionnaire with SOC 2 Type II evidence summary. Legal (Soojin) to review and confirm no unusual clauses in the MSA redline.
- AP to create a temporary vendor ID and tag invoices to project code HB-8342. No retroactive approvals beyond the cap.

Soojin — please review the attached MSA template and confirm if we need any additional clauses for pilot engagements (data residency / termination for convenience). Marcus — finance to provide the project code and invoice routing.

Once legal confirms, Rishi please open the procurement exception ticket and route to AP for vendor setup.

Laura Bennett

Cassidy — good news: leadership has approved a controlled exception so we can onboard the pilot without a standing PO, subject to the conditions below. Please treat this as a checklist to unblock: 

1) Sign the MSA via DocuSign: we’ll send the DocuSign link once legal redlines are confirmed.
2) Complete and return the security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.xlsx). Please attach SOC 2 summary.
3) Confirm billing contact and remit-to address for invoices (Redwood will require invoices routed to HB-8342).
4) AtlasML invoices should not exceed $35,000 total for the 90-day pilot window. Any spend above that requires an approved PO.

Attachments included for your reference: onboarding-form.pdf (how to submit invoices and billing codes). I’ll follow up with the DocuSign link and the HubSpot deal ID (HB-8342) for tracking.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you running.

–Kimberly
